input_messages.content: Hi, I’m having trouble with my mobile data. The internet on my phone is either extremely slow or just stops working altogether. I really need to get excellent internet speed—nothing less will do. I don’t have access to Wi-Fi, so I need this fixed as soon as possible. Can you help?
Sure, my name is John Smith and my phone number is 555-123-2002. Let me know if you need any more information to verify my account.

I just checked my phone, and it looks like Airplane Mode is currently enabled. Also, I see that VPN is connected. I am currently abroad in France, so yes, I am roaming outside my home network. What should I do next?
I’ve turned off Airplane Mode. My phone now shows a poor signal with 2G, mobile data is enabled, and Data Saver is on. The VPN is still connected. What should I do next?

I’ve set my phone to prefer 4G/5G networks, disconnected the VPN, and turned off Data Saver mode. My status bar now shows excellent signal strength with 5G and mobile data enabled. What should I do next?

I’ve rebooted my device, and after restarting, my phone still shows excellent 5G signal and mobile data enabled. However, I want to make sure the internet speed is actually excellent. What should I do next?

I tried running a speed test, but it failed and said there’s no connection. Even though my phone shows excellent 5G signal and data is enabled, I’m still not getting any internet access. What should I do now?
I’ve reset my APN settings as you suggested. Should I go ahead and reboot my device now, or is there anything else I need to do before restarting?

I’ve rebooted my device after resetting the APN settings. My phone still shows excellent 5G signal and mobile data enabled. Should I try running another speed test now to check if the internet speed is excellent?

I ran another speed test, but it still failed and says there’s no connection. Even though everything looks good on the status bar, I’m still not getting any internet access at all. What else can we try?
